title: Red Sox score bizarre run on sacrifice fly without tagging up from 3rd base
desc: Anthony Seigler scored from third base on a sacrifice fly Monday night — without ever tagging up on an inning-ending play. Needless to say, that left everyone in Toronto a little confused. Seigler scored Boston's only run in a 2-1 loss to the Blue Jays on a chaotic double play that resulted in a 17-minute delay trying to sort out the whole thing.

title: Semaglutide slows blood protein signature linked to future dementia risk
desc: A post hoc analysis of 2,970 older SELECT participants found that semaglutide slowed worsening of a 25-protein blood signature that predicts future dementia risk. Over 104 weeks, semaglutide produced larger effects on modeled 5-year than 20-year dementia risk, but whether these biomarker changes translate into less cognitive decline or dementia remains unknown.
